cards.explanation: The answer is His mother and brothers. Luke 8:19 says Jesus' mother and brothers came to see Him. Family showed up, and a whole crowd was standing between them and Him. I know that feeling, friends. Ever try to get to the front of a line when everybody's already in it?

The answer is False. Luke 8:19 says they were unable to reach Him because of the crowd. No walking right up to Him, friends. Then Luke 8:20 says He was told they were there, and that's what happens next.

The answer is outside. Someone tells Jesus, "Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to see You." (Luke 8:20) They're standing right there, just on the wrong side of that crowd. I think that has to feel rough, friends, standing out there while a whole crowd stays put.

The answer is those who hear God's word and carry it out. Jesus says, "My mother and brothers are those who hear the word of God and carry it out." (Luke 8:21) Two things go together there, friends: hearing and doing. It's like a recipe. Reading it won't give you a single cookie until you actually turn on the oven.
